comment: Self-hosted mesh networking (Headscale) — Phase 1. User overrides live in ~/.memory/config/network_provider.json. Real server_url/enabled values go there, not here.
server_url_comment: 8091 is just scripts/install_headscale.sh's starting guess, not a fixed requirement — it checks the port is actually free before using it and falls back automatically if not (found live 2026-07-23: the original guess, 8080, collided with LMStudio's API gateway on this machine). Match whatever port the installer actually reported.
